listing.name: VCMI
listing.summary: VCMI offers upstream packages for Heroes of Might and Magic III. Follow upstream setup before registering your executable.
listing.original_game_title: Heroes of Might and Magic III

steps.title: Get the upstream package
steps.instruction: Choose the release and package for your computer. Download and extract a portable archive, or use the upstream installer yourself.

steps.title: Complete upstream setup
steps.instruction: Use your Heroes III Complete or Shadow of Death game data, or the GOG offline installer and its BIN files, as described in the linked instructions.

steps.title: Select your executable
steps.instruction: After setup, choose the native game executable or upstream launcher and its working directory. Updates remain with you or the upstream launcher.

warnings: This project has not been verified for play through Portcove.
